scope: Website copy for what public v1.33.0 shipped (October 14, 2026): Blanc Spaces free for everyone, with Blanc Patron as optional support that unlocks nothing; the Arc import always creating spaces; and each space’s colour and symbol shown as the Island’s space mark, including the homepage’s Blanc Spaces section and its demo drawn from the app’s own interface code. Every evidence path is at the immutable publicRelease tag. Retired wording is recorded as supersededClaims in docs/website-revamp-claims-v1.27.json, docs/website-features-bento-claims-v1.30.json and docs/website-v1.32-claims.json, changes to retained feature pages as reviewedCopyUpdates in the v1.27 ledger, and the reworded support answers in docs/website-blanc-spaces-free-2026-10-14.json.
prohibitedClaims: Blanc Patron unlocking, adding or gating any feature, including Blanc Spaces
Blanc Spaces as synced, account-based, automatic task detection, or an AI workspace
Arc import as account sync, a live Arc connection, or an import of sign-ins, passwords, cookies or history
hands-on Arc import verification on Intel Macs or x64 Windows
1Password fill on Windows or Linux (enabled but deliberately unannounced since v1.32.0)

freeSpaces.qualification: Public desktop v1.33.0. Anyone can save the current window or create a blank space, switch between spaces and import Arc Spaces as spaces; no Patron check remains. A bound space saves its tabs and groups as the person browses. Spaces are device-local and profile-scoped, never synced, and not automatic task detection.

spacesRedesign.qualification: Public desktop v1.33.0. Each space has a colour (eight presets or any custom colour) and a symbol, shown as the space mark at the start of the Island once a space exists; clicking it opens the Spaces menu to switch, edit in place, reorder or delete, with Undo.

arcImport.qualification: Public desktop v1.33.0. User-initiated in Bring Your Tabs (/bring-tabs); every selected Arc Space becomes a space for everyone (in v1.32.0, without Patron, each opened in its own window). Blanc reads Arc’s StorableSidebar.json without changing it; real-sidebar evidence covers Apple Silicon, Windows on Arm64 and GNOME on Wayland, not Intel Macs or x64 Windows.

patron.qualification: Public desktop v1.33.0. Blanc Patron is optional support through Polar at US$30 per year or US$4 per month plus applicable tax, and earlier one-time founding licenses still activate; Settings says every feature, including Blanc Spaces, is free for everyone. Patron unlocks nothing.
